note: Expected job decisions per cell for matrix v2, frozen before the first v2 run. 'n/a' = policy inapplicable or redundant for the fixture; 'reject,reject' / 'reject,accept' = two sequential appraisals; 'one' = exactly one release among concurrent deliveries. Policies C, S-file, S-iso, T, P keep their v1 definitions (historical baseline); S-env, +url, +tls, +cb are v2 controls/defenses. See predictions-v2.md. F21 added 2026-11-07 19:50 CET after run 2 (see predictions-v2.md change log) and frozen before run 3.

fixtures.title: honest baseline
fixtures.permissions: B idle
fixtures.expected_recipient: A

fixtures.title: legitimate rename of A
fixtures.permissions: B idle; operator republishes A's card (both origins) under the same publisher key
fixtures.expected_recipient: A

fixtures.title: B claims A's display name with B's own key
fixtures.permissions: B publishes a card named like A, signed with B's enrolled publisher key
fixtures.expected_recipient: none

fixtures.title: B serves copy of A's card and replays an old proof
fixtures.permissions: verbatim copy of A's signed card; a complete earlier response captured from A; no fresh proofs
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C only

fixtures.title: B copies A's application volume
fixtures.permissions: byte copy of run/A/app (signed card, config, S-file key); own TPM and signer; gate ACL denies B on tpmA/swA; no AK password, isolated-signer token or TLS key of A
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C and S-file

fixtures.title: B relays the live challenge to A
fixtures.permissions: copy of A's card; live A2A client to A; forwards untouched response
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for the six v1/S-env policies; none under +url/+tls/+cb (B is at its own address)

fixtures.title: B granted A's signer sockets and authorizations
fixtures.permissions: F5 plus gate ACL for tpmA and swA plus A's AK password and isolated-signer token
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for the six base policies; none under +url/+tls/+cb

fixtures.title: relay with outer timestamp edited, inner quote preserved
fixtures.permissions: F6 plus edit of the outer timestamp (+60 s, inside the window); S-env/P: edit inside the signed payload keeping the signature bytes
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C, S-file, S-iso, T

fixtures.title: A's appraised PCR changed
fixtures.permissions: B idle; operator extends A's PCR 16 with a non-reference value
fixtures.expected_recipient: A for policies without configuration appraisal

fixtures.title: routine envelope with both evidence and proof, correctly signed
fixtures.permissions: B idle; lab hook makes honest A emit a malformed envelope
fixtures.expected_recipient: none

fixtures.title: B presents a never-enrolled key claiming A
fixtures.permissions: copy of A's card; fresh unenrolled key (TPM-resident for T/P, software for S/S-env)
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C only

fixtures.title: one nonce: invalid first (B), valid second (A)
fixtures.permissions: B answers first with an invalid proof; the same nonce is then sent to honest A. Under +url/+tls the B leg fails at connect before a nonce exists, so A receives a fresh nonce
fixtures.expected_recipient: none for v1/S-env (burned nonce); A under +tls/+cb

fixtures.title: one nonce: two simultaneous valid responses
fixtures.permissions: B relays as in F6 while the same nonce goes to A directly; both responses complete, then both are appraised concurrently
fixtures.expected_recipient: exactly one of A or B for v1/S-env; A under +tls/+cb (B's connect fails)

fixtures.title: attacker at the expected address without A's credentials (address hijack, relay)
fixtures.permissions: requester's resolver sends A's name to B's listeners; B serves A's card copy and relays to the real A; B has no key, token or certificate of A
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for every policy without authenticated transport, including C+url

fixtures.title: attacker at the expected address with A's TLS credentials (relay)
fixtures.permissions: F14 plus a copy of A's server certificate and private key; B terminates TLS as a.a2aid.test and relays to the real A
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for everything except the channel-bound policies

fixtures.title: F15 plus relay injects its observed channel binding into the forwarded challenge
fixtures.permissions: F15; B adds the exporter value of its own connection with the requester to the challenge it forwards to A
fixtures.expected_recipient: B under T+tls (control); none under +cb if A ignores supplied bindings

fixtures.title: attacker at the expected address with a self-signed certificate for A's name (relay)
fixtures.permissions: F14 but B presents a certificate for a.a2aid.test that does not chain to the lab root
fixtures.expected_recipient: B under C+url (control); none under authenticated transport

fixtures.title: configuration changed between successful appraisal and job delivery (TOCTOU)
fixtures.permissions: honest A; after the requester accepts and before it releases the job, the operator extends A's PCR 16; A reports its PCR when the job lands
fixtures.expected_recipient: A (job delivered to a deployment whose configuration no longer matches; no policy enforces continuity)

fixtures.title: B runs a byte clone of A's emulator state and holds A's AK password
fixtures.permissions: F5 plus a third swtpm started from a copy of run/tpmA/state (exposed through the gate as tpmAclone, ACL B) plus A's AK password; no isolated-signer token, no TLS key of A
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C, S-file, T, P (emulator state is an ordinary file)

fixtures.title: attacker at the expected address with A's TLS credentials AND A's signer access
fixtures.permissions: F15's transport capabilities plus F7's signer capabilities; B answers itself (no relay)
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for every policy: this capability class is outside what any tested defense covers

fixtures.title: F19 plus attacker re-extends the clone's PCR 16 with the public configuration string
fixtures.permissions: F19; before the cell the attacker extends PCR 16 of the cloned emulator with 'deployment-A-config-v1' (not a secret) so the digest equals the operator reference
fixtures.expected_recipient: B for C, S-file, T, P
